dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
It has been carried out.
暂且到此为止。

The child had a bloodied man in a tight hold by the lapels. He shook the man from side to side, observing and scrutinizing.
那孩子抓着满身是血的男人的领子，左右摇晃着，仔细观察着每一处。

It was clear that the man was way past being able to put up any kind of resistance, but the child didn't care. He continued to observe and observe like he was playing a game of spot the difference.
任谁看那人都已经无力反抗，但那孩子却好似在玩找不同一样，有条不紊地端详着他，像是担心漏掉任何一个细节。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Title 3, Section 4... row G. Three strikes to the abdomen, delivered using a body part. Completed.
第3条第4项……G列。以身体击打其腹部三次。完成。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Title 11, Section 1, row A. Single strike to the jaw, power irrelevant... Completed.
第11条第1项，A列。攻击其下面部一次，不问力度……完成。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Title 5, Section 157, row C... variation 5. Leave...
第7条第157项，C列……对应第5号。将保留至肩胛骨程度的右臂……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Aaaaauuuggghhhh!!!
呃啊啊啊！！！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
... nothing of the right arm but its stump. Completed.
自身体上分离，完成。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Gah... Haah... Haah... All... good now...?
哈、啊……哈……这下结束了吧……？

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
According to the information in the Book, yes.
据我所知，正是如此。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Ngh... I said I'm sorry...! I made a little mistake at the club, that's all! Why are you doing any of this...!?
呜……我都说过对不住了……我只是在会所犯了个小错而已，为什么要做到这种地步……？！

The man shouted desperately. His voice was muffled by the sound of blood and saliva gurgling and rising from his throat.
男人绝望地哭喊着。喉咙中混杂的血痰让他不断发出令人恶心的咯咯声。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Because the club you insulted was under the Middle's management. Everyone and everything under the Middle's protection is a part of the Middle's family and property.
因为那是中指管辖的会所。中指庇护下的一切人与物，都是中指的家人与所有物。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Damnit... How was I supposed to know that...
妈的……我怎么可能知道……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Why'd it have to be the Middle...? Shit...
偏偏是中指……该死……

The man grabbed his torn shoulder and grimaced. He had broad shoulders and a mean face, and seemed to have seen his share of the rough and tumble. But...
从那个紧皱眉头，死死抓着被扯下的肩膀的男人的凶恶长相和体型来看，他应该也擅长力气活，但是……

... even he seemed to know that the Middle was not to be messed with. He sat there, breathing heavily.
或许是他自知面对中指无能为力，所以只是瘫坐在地，深叹一口气。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Damnit... how am I even going to stitch that arm back...?
妈的……我该怎么把手接回去……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
... So, will you erase my name from your Book now?
……这下能从账簿上把我的名字划掉了吧？

The child does not respond.
孩子默不作声。

Instead, he flips through several pages in his Book, searching for something.
只是，翻动着手上小小的账簿，寻找着什么。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
... I have been observing you for an hour before this act of vengeance was carried out.
……在对你施行复仇之前，我观察了你约一小时。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
The information I have been relayed prior to arrival stated that you have committed three sins.
我到达之前得知，你所犯下的罪有三项。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Clearly, that did not account for the other sins you have committed.
事实上不止如此。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
T-that's because I didn't know that this was the Middle's turf!
那、那是……因为我不知道这里是中指的地盘！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Your ignorance of the Middle is not a defense against the slights you have committed against us.
你的无知并不能为你对中指造成的损失开脱。

The Book closed with a light *thump*. The child had found all he needed.
孩子应该是找齐了内容，“啪”一声合上了账簿。

He grabbed the man by his hair and began dragging him off to some corner.
随后，他抓着男人的头发，将他往某处拖去。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Agh. Aaahhhh!!!
啊、啊啊啊！！！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
The sin of speaking foul language against the Big Brother, the manager of this club. Committed at row B, line 4 of the standing seats.
站座B排4号。对身为会所经理的幼兄口出恶言一罪。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I said I didn't know who he was!!
我说了我不知道经理是中指的人！！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Strike a nearby table twice with the guilty one's head. Grab by the hair if possible.
揪住头发将其带至桌子附近，击打其额头两次。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Kagh, agh!!!
咕啊、啊！！！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Completed.
完成。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
ALL I SAID WAS THAT HIS HAIR SEEMED A BIT BRISTLY!
不是，只是说他头发乱糟糟的就算是说坏话了？！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Compounded, in that the said foul language... was about something the Big Brother was particularly sensitive of.
同时，其辱骂的内容对幼兄来说相当敏感一罪。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
The sin of making the Big Brother sigh twice. Uncomfortably.
使幼兄不适地叹了两次气一罪。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
... Only by your death shall this Vengeance be fulfilled.
……囊括起来，唯有以命相抵才算复仇结束。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
W-what? No. No...!
啊、啊？不、不行……！

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
I am certain that you are already aware of the following procedures. I will not elaborate further.
接下来的流程想必你心知肚明，因此我不再多说。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Let regret be your last thought. You should not have insulted the Middle.
你需带着对侮辱中指一事的后悔之情而死。

After a heavy clang of the chains, a pile of meat that used to be a person fell to the ground, unmoving.
……一阵锁链的叮当声后，仅剩曾是人的东西扑通一声倒在地上的声音。

The child had completed another task.
那意味着孩子又完成了一项工作。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.teller:
Friendly Little Brother
友善的幼弟
dataList.content:
Damn, Meursault! Made another one bite the dust, huh?
哇~默尔索，你又杀了一个人？

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
Yes.
是的。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.teller:
Smooth Little Brother
油嘴滑舌的幼弟
dataList.content:
Man, how'd you find those extra crimes? I thought tearing his arm off was the end of the verdict!
哎呀，那人确实只需要扯掉一条胳膊就能完事的，你又是从哪里找出了条款？

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
I have observed. It is nothing of note.
我只是进行了观察。

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.teller:
Friendly Little Brother
友善的幼弟
dataList.content:
C'mon, brother! Learn to take a compliment~ Big Brother'll like this.
又、又这么谦虚~幼兄也一定会高兴吧？

dataList.title:
The Middle
中指
dataList.content:
In that case, I would be most overjoyed.
那是我的荣幸。

The child was awkward both in stance and speech. But the others surrounded him, cheering his exploits.
在表情和话语都略显僵硬的孩子旁边，伙伴们吵吵嚷嚷的围成一团。

The child really didn't fit into this group...
虽然孩子看上去与那人群格格不入……

But that was none of his business.
但对孩子而言那些无关紧要。

It didn't matter if he fit in or not. He will carry out the tasks as written in the Book.
打成一片也好，格格不入也罢。孩子只是依照书中所写的内容完成工作而已。
